findings.title: Inconsistent collection type usage
findings.body: The class now uses a `list` for `_recent_batches` while the surrounding codebase and Python conventions typically favor `deque` for bounded collections with FIFO semantics. The change removes the `maxlen` behavior, which may affect the intended functionality of tracking the most recent batches.

findings.title: Loss of bounded collection behavior
findings.body: Replacing `deque(maxlen=2)` with a plain `list` removes the automatic eviction of older items when the collection exceeds two elements. This may cause unbounded memory growth if many batches are added, violating the intended design of tracking only the most recent two batches.

summary.problem: The change from `deque` to `list` for `_recent_batches` breaks the intended bounded collection behavior and introduces inconsistency with the codebase's conventions.
summary.done_well: The refactor simplifies the type annotation by removing the unused import of `deque`.
